scope: Laphroaig 10 Year Old Cask Strength batches 9 and 10 only. Runtime, matching, prices and image manifests remain outside this research task.
sourcePolicy: Exact-batch producer or retailer-published notes only; retailer notes must not be represented as official producer notes. Photographs are downloaded and visually checked before being marked verified.

sources.evidence: Explicit Batch 009/Batch 9, age ten, 2017, 58.1%, 70cl, original distillery bottling. Product photograph visually confirms FEB 17, 009, age ten and 58.1%. Tasting Notes section is empty.
Independently confirms Batch 009, age ten, February 2017, 58.1% and 700ml.

Exact Batch 009 listing, 700ml and 58.1% (page typesets this as 58..1%). Published nose notes identify maritime, vanilla, citrus and peat smoke; palate identifies cantaloupe, lemon peel, spiced oak, salted butter and smoke; finish retains sweetness and smoke.

entries.proposedDescription: 2017년 2월에 병입한 10년 캐스크 스트렝스 배치 9. 58.1% 도수에 바다 향과 피트 연기, 시트러스의 달콤함이 어우러진다.

proposedNotes.nose: 바다 향에 포근한 바닐라와 시트러스, 피트 연기가 겹친다
proposedNotes.palate: 달콤한 멜론과 레몬 껍질, 오크 향신료에 소금기 있는 버터와 은은한 연기
proposedNotes.finish: 달콤함과 스모키한 기운이 균형 있게 이어지는 여운

notesProvenance.scope: Exact Batch 009 product page. No producer attribution is given; these are retailer-published notes, not officially verified producer notes.

photoCandidates.labelEvidence: Bottle and tube visibly read batch 009, FEB 17 bottled, aged 10 years, 58.1% vol and 70 cl. Real bottle-and-tube photograph with a white background and reflection below.

cautions: Retailer-published notes are not explicitly producer-attributed.
Do not use CaskCartel's Batch 009 listing: its body wrongly states 2019 and 58.6%, conflating another batch.

sources.evidence: Exact Batch 010 page specifies age ten, 58.0%, 2018 and 700ml. Photo independently shows JAN 18, 010, age ten and 58%. Retailer nose emphasizes charred barbecue, iodine, brine and old wood; palate includes vegetal peat smoke, charred meat, vanilla, nutty malt, pepper and oily texture; finish is long with spiced oak, oily peat and receding smoke.
Independently identifies Batch 010 as the 2018 release at 58% ABV, matured in seasoned charred oak barrels. Personal tasting notes were not used in the proposal.

entries.proposedDescription: 2018년 1월에 병입한 10년 캐스크 스트렝스 배치 10. 58% 도수에 짙은 피트와 바닷소금, 바닐라와 후추가 겹친다.

proposedNotes.nose: 그을린 바비큐와 흙내음, 요오드와 바닷소금에 오래된 나무 향
proposedNotes.palate: 풀내음 섞인 피트 연기와 구운 고기, 바닐라·견과류·몰트·검은 후추가 오일리하게 어우러진다
proposedNotes.finish: 오크 향신료와 기름진 피트, 서서히 옅어지는 연기가 길게 이어진다

notesProvenance.scope: Exact Batch 010 product page. No producer attribution is given; these are retailer-published notes, not officially verified producer notes. Notes expressly described as appearing after water was added were omitted from this concise proposal.

photoCandidates.labelEvidence: Bottle and tube visibly read batch 010, JAN 18 bottled, aged 10 years, 58% vol and 70 cl. Real bottle-and-tube photograph on a counter with blurred store shelves behind.

cautions: Retailer-published notes are not explicitly producer-attributed.
The verified photo has a store background, not a plain white background.
Master of Malt's sku=82217 page currently renders a newer generic cask-strength product despite its indexed Batch 010 title; it was not used for notes.
K&L's Batch 010 page has a conflicting 58.1% specification and includes an older 2015 Wine Enthusiast review, so those details were not used.
